Theorem
[Short time existence] Source: topping:page-0062, topping:page-0063 ↗ topping:variation-ricci ↗ topping:lie-derivative-symmetric-gradient 1. ch5:2.1\group topping-ricci-flow-existence

For every smooth metric $g_0$ on a closed manifold $\M $, there are $\epsilon >0$ and a smooth metric family $g(t)$ on $[0,\epsilon ]$ satisfying \[ \begin{cases} \dfrac {\partial g}{\partial t}=-2\Ric (g) & t\in [0,\epsilon ],\\ g(0)=g_0. \end{cases} \tag {5.2.2} \]

Proof

\sketch Solve the parabolic DeTurck equation $\partial _tg=P(g)$ with initial metric $g_0$. The flow of

\[ X=-(T^{-1}\dG (T))^\# \]

produces diffeomorphisms $\psi _t$ with $\psi _0=\id $. Pulling the DeTurck solution back by $\psi _t$ removes the Lie-derivative term and gives the required Ricci flow.
